The legendary assassin turned convenience store owner is BACK like you've never seen him before! Meanwhile, Nagumo, Shishiba, and Osaragi of the Order head to Kyoto on a mission, only to be ambushed by an unexpected assassin…!
Watch Season 1 now, and catch all new episodes from Season 2 on January 18, only on Netflix.
